status: NEGATIVE RESULT, reported per the pre-registration
headline: The first RL run in this project with adequate gradient updates and a healthy critic still DEGRADED the policy: reach and grasp fell from 0.20 to 0.00 and mean return from 0.549 to -0.51 on the frozen 25-condition suite under the same v3 predicate.

critic_health_reported_first_as_pre_regi.q_plateau: ~3.7-4.9, the value a reliably-grasping policy is worth under v3 bonuses with gamma_chunk 0.98
critic_health_reported_first_as_pre_regi.verdict: HEALTHY. This is the value-learning branch of the pre-registered test, not overestimation. The critic-loss median improved monotonically and Q plateaued near the achievable return.

why_this_matters: Run 1's degradation was attributed to an unfitted critic (critic_loss 0.15 -> 8.39, still rising at 150 updates). That hypothesis is now REFUTED: with 2700 updates and a demonstrably well-fitted critic, the policy degraded anyway. The cause is elsewhere.

measured_mechanism.collapse_timing: episodes 0-3 reached 2,0,2,3 stages; from episode 4 onward every episode reached 0.

entropy_term_died.reading: The entropy term is now 0.3% of the actor objective. SAC's exploration pressure is effectively switched off, so the actor follows Q alone.

measured_mechanism.resulting_behaviour: mean_disp_m 0.0091 -- the pipette barely moves; the policy stopped acting.

hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.smoothness_penalty_dominating: REFUTED by measurement -- at SMOOTH_LAMBDA=100 the CAPS penalty on real demonstration motion is 0.0025 weighted, against stage bonuses of 1.0-4.0. It is three orders of magnitude too small to matter.
hypotheses_tested_and_refuted.throughput: REFUTED -- 2700 updates, 18x run 1, at a measured 1.23 s/update.

leading_remaining_hypothesis: Entropy collapse. alpha fell monotonically for the entire run and the entropy term reached 0.3% of the objective. The target entropy (-8.4) was verified reachable under correlated noise BEFORE the run, so this is not the pilot-collapse mode; but the temperature learning rate (ALPHA_LR 1e-3) may be too high relative to how fast the policy's own log-prob moves, letting alpha chase downward faster than the policy adapts. UNTESTED.
honest_status: Three of the six review fixes (reward, discount, critic conditioning) have still not been shown to help, because every run so far has failed for a different reason -- throughput, an import, and now entropy collapse. What HAS been established is the specification-gaming finding, which does not depend on any training run.
